title: Cleaning the trombone
summary: Henry describes cleaning with kerosene, a swab and baking soda rinse.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Well, this instrument's got a nice tone. All you gotta do is keep it cleaned out.
How do you clean your trombone? What do you use to clean your trombone?
Well, I take this part, take a swab, run down here with some kerosene oil.
Through the bell and all, big swab?
